notes.title: Mac and Linux versions released
notes.content:
Hello,

After we goofed up with the Mac and Linux release, we are happy to announce these operating systems are now supported too. The binaries should be automatically downloaded if you have purchased the game already.

If you experience any problems, let us know in the comments below!
